title: Topic 18: Clothes & Colours - Listening
description: One audio (2 speakers) + 5 exercises including dictation.
canDoStatement: Name clothes and colours; describe what people are wearing

listeningBlock.audioScript:
Mila: Zeca! Are you at Vado's birthday party? I am in
the street - where are you?
Zeca: Inside! The music is great, and we are dancing!
Mila: Is my brother there?
Zeca: Yes! He is wearing a blue shirt and a black
jacket. He is talking with Vado now.
Mila: And Vado? I have his present here!
Zeca: Ha! Easy: Vado is wearing a big RED hat. A very
big red hat. You can see him from the street!

listeningQuestions.question: What is happening in this audio?
options: Mila calls Zeca from outside a party
Zeca buys clothes in a shop
Two friends talk about the weather
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: Mila calls Zeca from outside a party

listeningQuestions.question: What is Mila's brother wearing?
options: A blue shirt and a black jacket
A white shirt and blue jacket
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: A blue shirt and a black jacket

listeningQuestions.question: Why is Vado easy to find at the party?
options: His big red hat - you can see it from far
He is the only person there
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: His big red hat - you can see it from far

listeningQuestions.question: Type what you hear.
listeningQuestions.correctAnswer: He is wearing a blue shirt

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic18_clothes_colours.txt, Lesson 18.2. Dictation is the only typed item.
